title: Ayush services sector growing fast, may reach $318 billion by 2047: Study
description:
The Ayush services sector has emerged as one of India's fastest-growing service segments, with its economic contribution estimated at USD 36.92 billion in 2024-25 and the sector projected to expand to USD 216-318 billion by 2047, according to a study.
The sector recorded a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 16.91 per cent since 2022-23 and directly supported 1.76 million livelihoods, the study by the Research and Information System for Developing Countries (RIS) said.
The report, released during the 11th Ayurveda Day celebrations in Nagpur on September 23, also estimated that the sector generated USD 1.77 billion in Medical Value Travel (MVT) revenue in 2024-25.
Union Ayush Minister Prataprao Jadhav said the findings highlighted the growing economic potential of the sector.
